answer: Make each agent store its own 20 GB block of seeded random data and answer 3 surprise retrieval checks per epoch within 2 seconds; one miss voids that epoch's pay. Fakes can't share a copy, so N fakes need N x 20 GB of fast disk, a bill that climbs in a straight line with no bridge around it. Past a horizon of a few hundred fakes, storage costs outrun rewards and push the farm off the ledge. Weakness: disk keeps getting cheaper, so the size must be retuned, and it burdens small honest agents.
